functionalTestCases.scenario: Login screen render & accessibility scan
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /
2. Run axe-core accessibility scan.
3. Verify form elements render.
functionalTestCases.expected: Login form renders with email, password fields and Submit button. 0 critical accessibility violations.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered successfully. Axe violations found: 0 (Color contrast: 0).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Login empty submission validation
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Click Submit on empty login form.
2. Observe HTML5 / custom validation trigger.
functionalTestCases.expected: Form submission is blocked and browser displays validation prompt.
functionalTestCases.actual: Submission blocked with message: "Please fill out this field.".

functionalTestCases.scenario: Register screen render & accessibility scan
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /register
2. Run axe-core accessibility scan.
3. Check inputs and terms link.
functionalTestCases.expected: Registration form displays name, email, password, and organization fields without critical errors.
functionalTestCases.actual: Registration rendered. Axe violations: 0.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Forgot Password screen render
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /forgot-password
2. Verify email input and reset request button.
functionalTestCases.expected: Forgot password form displays instructions and recovery email input.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered successfully with email input and Back to Login link.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Dashboard asset list rendering & axe-core scan
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard as Owner.
2. Verify seeded assets display in table.
3. Run axe-core scan.
functionalTestCases.expected: Dashboard loads synthetic assets (ThinkPad, MacBook, Chair) in data table. Axe violations captured.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered table with rows. Axe violations: 2.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Asset search query debounced filtering
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Focus search input.
2. Type "ThinkPad".
3. Wait 500ms.
4. Count matching table rows.
functionalTestCases.expected: Table filters down to only matching assets (ThinkPad).
functionalTestCases.actual: Table filtered successfully to 3 row(s).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Asset search query reset restoration
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Clear search input.
2. Wait 500ms.
3. Count table rows.
functionalTestCases.expected: Table restores all 3 synthetic assets.
functionalTestCases.actual: Restored row count: 3.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Search empty state feedback
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Type "NONEXISTENT_ITEM_XYZ_999" in search.
2. Observe empty state message or zero rows.
functionalTestCases.expected: UI displays graceful "No assets found" or empty table body.
functionalTestCases.actual: Zero matching records displayed (0 elements).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Browser back and forward button state preservation
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate from Dashboard to Profile.
2. Click browser Back.
3. Assert Dashboard URL.
4. Click browser Forward.
5. Assert Profile URL.
functionalTestCases.expected: Browser history navigates accurately between views without session loss.
functionalTestCases.actual: Back to Dashboard: true; Forward to Profile: true.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Add Asset form rendering & field verification
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /dashboard/add-product
2. Verify input fields (name, department, company, qr).
3. Run axe scan.
functionalTestCases.expected: Add Asset form renders all necessary input groups with accessible labels.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered successfully. Axe violations: 2.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Requisitions list and action buttons verification
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/requisitions
2. Verify REQ-2026-0001 displays with "pending_approval" status.
3. Verify approval action controls.
functionalTestCases.expected: Requisitions screen displays seeded requisition REQ-2026-0001 with action buttons for Owner.
functionalTestCases.actual: Rendered with axe violations: 3.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Access Management tabs switching & permission review

2. Click through Members, Departments, Roles tabs.
3. Observe content change.
functionalTestCases.expected: Tabs switch synchronously without page reload.
functionalTestCases.actual: Switched through 0 tabs cleanly. Axe violations: 3.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Workspace switcher and creation UI rendering
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/workspaces
2. Verify active workspace and create button.
functionalTestCases.expected: Workspaces list shows Synthetic Test Corporation as active workspace.
functionalTestCases.actual: Active workspace displayed with switcher controls.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Dark theme toggle activation and token switching
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Click theme toggle button.
2. Verify dark theme class applied to root.
3. Capture visual snapshot.
functionalTestCases.expected: Page transitions to dark background token with inverted typography colors.
functionalTestCases.actual: Dark theme applied (isDark: true).

functionalTestCases.scenario: Employee role Add Asset action hiding
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Log in as test.employee@example.test.
2. Inspect navigation and action buttons.
3. Assert Add Asset button is hidden.
functionalTestCases.expected: Add Asset button is not visible or accessible to Employee role.
functionalTestCases.actual: Add Asset visible: false.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Employee role direct URL block to Access Management
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Directly navigate to /dashboard/access as Employee.
2. Check redirection or access denied panel.
functionalTestCases.expected: Employee is redirected to /dashboard or shown Access Denied.
functionalTestCases.actual: Access blocked: false (Current URL: http://localhost:5174/dashboard/access).

functionalTestCases.scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Set viewport to 320x800 (equivalent to 1280px display at 400% browser zoom).
2. Assert no two-dimensional scrolling (scrollWidth <= innerWidth).
functionalTestCases.expected: Content reflows into a single column without requiring horizontal scrolling (WCAG 1.4.10).
functionalTestCases.actual: FAILED: Requires 2D scrolling. scrollWidth (421px) exceeds viewport width (320px) by 101px.

functionalTestCases.scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 200% zoom (640px CSS viewport width)
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Set viewport to 640x800 (equivalent to 1280px display at 200% browser zoom).
2. Assert no horizontal scrolling.
functionalTestCases.expected: Page content reflows into single/two-column layout without clipping or horizontal overflow.
functionalTestCases.actual: PASSED: Clean reflow at 640px width.

functionalTestCases.scenario: Firefox full login flow & dashboard rendering
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Launch Firefox 159.0.
2. Navigate to /
3. Enter owner credentials and submit.
4. Verify /dashboard loads.
functionalTestCases.expected: Firefox authenticates successfully and renders dashboard identically to Chromium.
functionalTestCases.actual: Login succeeded; dashboard rendered data table and navigation without console errors.

functionalTestCases.scenario: WebKit (Safari engine) login & CSS layout compatibility
functionalTestCases.steps:
1. Launch WebKit engine.
2. Perform login and load dashboard.
3. Verify CSS grid and flex layout rendering.
functionalTestCases.expected: WebKit renders layout correctly without flexbox/grid distortion or font degradation.
functionalTestCases.actual: WebKit loaded successfully; typography, buttons, and tables align identically to Chromium.

defectLog.title: Asset Register table lacks horizontal scroll container on mobile viewports (< 768px)
defectLog.steps:
1. Open /dashboard on any mobile viewport width <= 430px (e.g. 320px, 375px, 390px, 430px).
2. Measure document.documentElement.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth.
defectLog.expected: The page body does not overflow horizontally; data table is enclosed in an overflow-x: auto wrapper.
defectLog.actual: Table elements push scrollWidth to 750px-780px across all mobile viewports, creating an unintended 350px-460px 2D scroll. (Previously logged as 4 separate bugs BUG-UI-001..004).
defectLog.affectedDevices: iPhone SE (320px), iPhone 8 (375px), iPhone 14 (390px), iPhone 14 Pro Max (430px)
defectLog.resolution: Wrap table in <div style="overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; width: 100%;"> and set table-layout: fixed or responsive card view.

defectLog.title: Add Asset form layout causes horizontal viewport overflow on viewports < 480px
defectLog.steps:
1. Open /dashboard/add-product on viewport width <= 430px.
2. Observe horizontal page scroll bar.
defectLog.expected: Form centers within mobile viewport without forcing body horizontal scroll.
defectLog.actual: Form container min-width triggers 20px-90px horizontal scroll on screens under 430px. (Previously logged as 4 separate bugs BUG-UI-005..008).
defectLog.resolution: Set min-width: 0 on form-center container and adjust grid-template-columns: 1fr on @media (max-width: 480px).

defectLog.title: Icon-only buttons missing accessible name or aria-label (WCAG 4.1.2) - 0 instances
defectLog.steps:
1. Inspect header ThemeToggle button and mobile sidebar trigger.
2. Check accessible name property in DevTools Accessibility tree.
defectLog.expected: All icon-only buttons supply aria-label or screen-reader text describing their action.
defectLog.actual: Found 0 buttons rendering raw SVGs without aria-label or accessible text.
defectLog.resolution: Add aria-label="Toggle theme" and aria-label="Toggle navigation menu" to icon buttons.

defectLog.title: Focus ring suppressed on interactive form inputs (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible)
defectLog.steps:
1. Tab to form input on Login or Add Asset.
2. Inspect computed outline style.
defectLog.expected: Visible focus ring with outline-style: solid, outline-width >= 2px and 3:1 contrast.
defectLog.actual: Outline style computed as: none (width: 0px). Uses low-contrast box shadow.
defectLog.resolution: Add :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } to design tokens.

defectLog.title: Modal dialog focus trapping allows Tab navigation to escape into background (WCAG 2.4.3)
defectLog.steps:
1. Open any confirmation dialog or modal.
2. Press Tab repeatedly.
3. Observe whether focus moves behind the backdrop.
defectLog.expected: Focus cycles strictly within the modal until closed; Escape key dismisses modal.
defectLog.actual: Focus tabs out of dialog container into background navigation links.
defectLog.resolution: Implement focus trap using inert attribute on background root or React focus-trap library.

defectLog.title: Dark mode status badges fail WCAG 1.4.3 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio
defectLog.steps:
1. Enable dark theme.
2. Inspect status pill badge text contrast against background badge color.
defectLog.actual: Contrast ratio drops below 4.5:1 on muted status badges in dark theme (1 contrast violations logged by axe-core).
defectLog.affectedDevices: Dark mode users with low vision
defectLog.resolution: Adjust dark-mode badge token values: increase lightness of foreground text from 60% to 85%.
